detail.longDescription: Bought the second edition of Site Reliability Engineering, the Google SRE book. Ten years after the first one, and Google calls it a complete rewrite rather than a refresh. Confession time. I never read the first edition, even though half the industry learned to talk about SLOs, error budgets and postmortems from it. So I am skipping straight to the new one, which covers burn-rate alerting, OpenTelemetry, infrastructure as code, internal developer platforms, and a whole new part about running AI infrastructure and using AI during incidents. I bought it mostly for the platform engineering side. Platforms are my daily work now, and I want to see where Google draws the line between a platform team and SRE. Paper copy, because some books I still want to hold in my hands. Starting tonight. # SRE # SiteReliabilityEngineering # DevOps # PlatformEngineering # OReilly # Books
